provides.label: WeftMark product and implementation design
provides.description: Prototype runtime and repository-grounded architecture for local Change Sets, semantic claims, Git lineage, evidence, review, handoff, CLI/status, and read-only board/mobile projections.

dependencies.reason: SQLite and test extras require compatible Nostoi releases; uv selects the hash-locked Linux amd64 wheel, with verified release source fallback on other platforms.
SQLite uses the native Python binding; optional ledger verify/attest and CAD intake use the external CLI. JSONL-only operation needs neither.

SQLite-enabled tests/builds consume released bindings; CAD CI installs a signature/hash-verified release CLI rather than compiling Rust. Other platforms may build the pinned release bindings from source.
Workspace attestation verification loads the sibling nostoi reference implementation from contrib/python.

adminSurfaces.name: task-plan
adminSurfaces.description: YAML-compatible implementation task graph under tasks/.

security.revocation: No remote mutation surface exists in the prototype. The HTTP read surface is loopback-only; its optional local bearer token is replaced by restarting with a different token file.

catalog.name: WeftMark
catalog.short: Vendor-neutral ledger for multi-agent software work: scope, Git lineage, evidence, handoff, and review.
catalog.value: WeftMark is RAGBAZ's internal control plane for multi-agent software work — Local Change Sets, semantic claims, Git lineage, evidence, review, handoff, CLI/status surfaces, and a read-only Kanban/mobile review client. It grows out of the operational primitives already proven in RAGBAZ Frog. Prototype runtime, not a released or supported product.
